title: List the display names of users who posted content in 2011 with view counts
question: List the display names of users who posted content in 2011 with view counts exceeding the average view count across all posts, and who also placed a bounty of exactly 50 on any post whose title contains the word 'variance'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p."XCL_029") = '2011'
  AND p."XCL_030" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_030") FROM posts)
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_033" FROM posts
    WHERE "XCL_039" = 50 AND "XCL_035" LIKE '%variance%'
  )
